events.description: Monica Geller says Monica Geller is asking Phoebe Buffay what happened during Paolo's massage appointment with Phoebe Buffay.
Phoebe Buffay says Paolo came in for a massage with Phoebe Buffay.
Phoebe Buffay says that during the early part of Paolo's massage session, everything was fine.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller is asking Phoebe Buffay if Phoebe Buffay is sure about her account of Paolo's behavior during the massage.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay is sure about what happened during Paolo's massage with Phoebe Buffay.
Phoebe Buffay says that during the massage, Paolo's visible arousal became the problem instead of Paolo's hands.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller is asking if the problem Phoebe Buffay is referring to was Paolo's erection creating a tent under the sheet during the massage.
Phoebe Buffay says Paolo's arousal during the massage created such a tent under the sheet that boy scouts could have camped under it.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller is thanking Rachel Green.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing is asking Phoebe Buffay what Phoebe Buffay is going to do next about Paolo's inappropriate behavior toward Phoebe Buffay.

Ross Geller says Phoebe Buffay has to tell Rachel Green about Paolo's inappropriate behavior during the massage; Ross Geller says telling Rachel Green is Phoebe Buffay's moral obligation as a friend and as a woman, and Ross Geller thinks it is a feminist issue.
Joey Tribbiani says he also thought it was a feminist issue.
Phoebe Buffay says Rachel Green is going to hate Phoebe Buffay if Phoebe Buffay tells Rachel Green about Paolo's behavior during the massage.
